description: Mobile polish and PWA: Responsive design improvements across all key pages, touch-friendly interactions, PWA manifest, service worker, and mobile-specific optimizations
steps: Create public/manifest.json (PWA web app manifest) with app name 'StockFlow', short_name 'StockFlow', start_url '/', display 'standalone', theme_color '#10b981', background_color '#0a0a0a', and icons array (192x192 and 512x512 PNG placeholders). Create placeholder icons at public/icons/icon-192x192.png and public/icons/icon-512x512.png (simple green S logo SVG converted or solid colored placeholder).
Create public/sw.js - a basic service worker with cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first for API calls. Register it in src/main.tsx using navigator.serviceWorker.register.

Add PWA meta tags to index.html: <link rel='manifest' href='/manifest.json'>, <meta name='theme-color' content='#10b981'>, <meta name='apple-mobile-web-app-capable' content='yes'>, <meta name='apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style' content='black-translucent'>, viewport meta with viewport-fit=cover

Create src/components/layout/MobileBottomNav.tsx - a fixed bottom navigation bar visible only on mobile (md:hidden) with 5 key icons: Dashboard (LayoutDashboard), Products (Package), Scanner (ScanBarcode), Orders (ShoppingCart), More (Menu that opens sidebar). Use the same active state styling as Sidebar. Only render when user is authenticated.

Integrate MobileBottomNav into src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx - render it at the bottom of the layout on mobile, and add pb-16 padding to main content area on mobile to account for the bottom nav height

Add responsive improvements to src/index.css: safe-area-inset padding support for notched devices (env(safe-area-inset-bottom)), touch-action manipulation for faster taps, -webkit-tap-highlight-color transparent, and ensure .bento-grid has a single column on mobile (below 640px)
Add mobile-specific touch improvements: ensure all buttons have min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] touch targets in mobile view by adding a utility class .touch-target in index.css that can be applied
Update src/components/shared/DataTable.tsx to improve mobile experience: on screens < 768px, add horizontal scroll indicator, make first column sticky, and reduce padding on mobile
acceptance_criteria: MobileBottomNav appears on viewport width < 768px with 5 navigation icons
PWA manifest.json is served at /manifest.json with correct metadata
DataTable is horizontally scrollable on mobile with sticky first column
pnpm build succeeds with no TypeScript errors
verification: Run 'pnpm build' and confirm it succeeds with exit code 0
Run 'pnpm lint' and confirm no errors
findings: Build passes successfully. Lint has 10 pre-existing errors/warnings (netlify/functions/health.ts, Invoices.tsx, Payments.tsx, SalesOrders.tsx, ai/providers.ts, ai/streaming.ts) - none from FEAT-003 changes. PWA icons are minimal placeholder PNGs (4x4 green pixels). Service worker in public/ copies as-is to dist. MobileBottomNav uses SidebarContext setMobileOpen for the More button.
